question: Can a learned local producer scorer supply product/input/capacity/investment scores inside the deterministic EXP-0010B planner, preserving feasibility and permutation behavior while improving the deterministic planner or v4 under the current stochastic product-stream champion orderer?
scope: learned scorer contract and local training/eval plumbing only; no production auction or command changes; no strict-envelope promotion audit

implementation.planner: plan_producer_command accepts optional ProducerLocalScores; the planner still enforces headroom, funding, replenish ceilings, and running investment locks
implementation.scorer: tokenomics.train.producer_scorer.ProducerScoreModel uses shared global/capacity/product/input row encoders plus sparse product-capacity and product-input relation pooling
implementation.training: collect_producer_score_samples records rollout ProducerEntityView states and local score labels; fit_producer_score_model trains by supervised MSE
implementation.deployment: producing_entity_planner_from_scorer adapts any scorer closure to the existing producer Box action contract
implementation.checkpoint: save_producer_score_model/load_producer_score_model provide a versioned scorer artifact format

gates.permutation: row-order invariant public scores when rows and sparse relations are permuted together
gates.feasibility: learned or external scores cannot exceed planner headroom constraints

smoke.training_slice: tiny default-topology p4 input-stock label grid; 16 samples; 60 epochs; lr 0.03
